security.body:
<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Will Cook -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->

# Security

This is a scholarly code-and-document archive, not a network service. It ships
no credentials or background service. Its security surface is the code a user
chooses to run, the pinned Lean and Mathlib dependencies, release-only Python
packages, and the continuous-integration configuration.

## Before you run anything

Cloning downloads tracked files but does not run this project's Python or Lean
code. The repository defines no submodules, Git LFS filters, or repository
hooks. You can use the reader sparse checkout in the README to inspect the
papers, claim records, open boundaries, and source map before executing a
project command.

The trust boundary changes when you run code. The read-only query commands
execute tracked Python. A Lean build also installs or invokes the exact Lean
toolchain in `lean-toolchain` and the Mathlib revision in `lake-manifest.json`.
Release-only Python packages are version- and hash-pinned in
`scripts/requirements-release.txt`, and GitHub Actions dependencies are pinned to full
commit hashes. The release workflow checks for prohibited proof shortcuts,
private path leaks, stale generated evidence, and suspect material reachable
through Git history.

No repository can guarantee that executing unfamiliar code is risk-free. If
you need to treat the checkout as hostile, inspect the commit and lock files
first and run it in a disposable virtual machine or container with no secrets
or write access to important files. A green Lean build establishes proof
checking for the imported declarations; it is not a general security audit.

Report privately through
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/security/advisories/new).

Use it for anything sensitive: a supply-chain concern in the pinned
toolchain or dependencies, a CI configuration issue, or leaked material that
should not be public. Do not open a public issue with sensitive details.
Mathematical errors and build failures are not security issues; use the
[ordinary issue forms](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/issues/new/choose)
for those. Reports get a best-effort response from a solo maintainer, normally
within a week.

code-of-conduct.body:
<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Will Cook -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->

# Code of conduct

This repository exists so people can criticise, reuse, correct, and extend
public mathematical work. Participation should make that work easier to inspect
and safer to continue.

## Expected conduct

- Address claims, proofs, code, evidence, attribution, and decisions directly.
- Give credit to the people and sources that supplied material work.
- State uncertainty and surviving mathematical limits plainly.
- Accept good-faith correction and allow other contributors to disagree.
- Protect private or sensitive information.

## Unacceptable conduct

Harassment, threats, sustained unwanted contact, sexualised conduct, personal
attacks, deliberate intimidation, or publishing another person's private
information are not accepted. Discrimination based on identity, background,
disability, experience, education, or another personal characteristic is also
not accepted. Criticising a mathematical assertion or rejecting a contribution
on evidence is not, by itself, a violation.

## Scope and enforcement

This standard applies to issues, pull requests, reviews, repository-linked
discussions, and other spaces where somebody represents this project. The
maintainer may edit or remove comments, close contributions, limit interaction,
or block an account when needed to enforce it. Decisions should identify the
conduct at issue without exposing confidential reports.

Report a possible violation privately through
[GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/wcook04/plectis-erdos/security/advisories/new).
Say that the report concerns conduct rather than software security. Reports get
a best-effort response from a solo maintainer, normally within a week. Do not
put sensitive details in a public issue.

credit-policy.body:
<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Will Cook -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 -->

# Credit and stewardship

Credit follows the accepted work. A receipt names the person who returned it
and the exact public files, results, or evidence being credited. It does not
reassign authorship of the surrounding corpus or imply that every idea from an
exploration became part of the accepted result.

A contributor may be different from a collaborator, a tool operator, or a
disclosed model or service used during the work. The receipt records those
roles separately. This makes assistance visible without obscuring human
responsibility or inventing authorship. It does not guess at undisclosed use.

Within artifact credit, optional CRediT-aligned roles describe what each person
supplied: for example conceptualization, formal analysis, investigation,
methodology, software, validation, visualization, or writing. Multiple roles
may apply. The role list describes contributions; it does not by itself decide
authorship, ownership, correctness, or priority.

Positive, negative, inconclusive, and corrective work can all receive credit.
The returned artifact must be useful, bounded, traceable, and accepted. It does
not need to look like a theorem or increase a score. The repository does not
rank contributors by commits, lines changed, receipt counts, model usage, or
another activity count.

Architecture ideas and implementations receive the same treatment. An adopted
idea should become a public design note, implementation, test, or other tracked
artifact that cites the proposal and names its originator. An issue mention by
itself is delivery history; the accepted artifact and receipt make the credit
durable in every clone.

Submission is not acceptance. Issues, pull requests, and Git history preserve
the delivery history, but work appears on the accepted credit pages only after
a receipt is committed against an exact public commit. Acceptance alone does
not establish correctness, novelty, peer review, release inclusion, or a
change in mathematical claim status. Each of those needs its own evidence.

Corrections preserve lineage. A newer receipt names the earlier return and
records whether it retains, supersedes, or withdraws the affected artifact.
The earlier contributor and historical evidence remain discoverable. Disputes
about attribution should be handled as corrective contributions with concrete
artifact and provenance evidence rather than by rewriting history silently.

All contributions remain subject to the repository's licences and source
attribution requirements. A contributor should cite prior work, identify any
material collaborators, and state limitations honestly. Maintainers must keep
the credit narrow, durable, public, and no stronger than the accepted evidence.

problem-library.body:
# Papers and Lean source by problem

[Choose a problem on the website](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis/maths/).
Every problem has a short paper, a long paper, and a searchable source map.
PDF and TeX links point to stable file paths on this repository's `main` branch.
The website's HTML reader is a published snapshot.

`docs/problem_library.json` is the public machine-readable source for that view.
It is separate from the bounded `docs/problems.json` entry index. Each problem
contains `papers`, `paper_roles`, and a `source_map` with module nodes and import
edges. Import arrows describe source dependencies, not theorem strength or
mathematical credit. Only local Lean modules are included.

To refresh the library after changing source or paper records, run from a full
checkout (the reader-only sparse checkout intentionally omits Lean source):

```sh
python3 scripts/build_problem_index.py
python3 scripts/build_problem_index.py --check
python3 scripts/test_problem_library.py
```

Paper identities and short/long roles come from `docs/papers/corpus.json`.
Keep a paper's `paper_id` and file paths when revising it; rebuild and commit its
PDF with the TeX source. Title and page-count changes do not change its URL.
When adding a paper, its corpus record needs explicit problem membership
(`problem_ids`, or its existing numbered `subject`), publication state, form,
and paths to the PDF, TeX, and full text. Missing files fail the build.
The long manuscripts are assembled from `paper/reasoning-parts/`; use
`python3 scripts/assemble_reasoning_surfaces.py --check` to check agreement.

Source-map roots come from each problem directory, principal and companion
modules, reviewed result sources, and explicitly linked claims. The builder
reads actual Lean imports and follows their local dependencies recursively.
Each node carries its source digest and current GitHub URL; the library records
input digests so consumers can reject a mismatched claim snapshot.

source_authority.proof_authority: Lean source checked by the pinned kernel

selection_contract.authority_basis: Every source family is read from the exact committed HEAD:docs/claims.json review matrix plus the explicitly recorded theorem-forest discoveries; the exact committed HEAD:verification/comparator.json roster is a nested evidence/admission screen. Uncommitted Comparator edits, roster order, and ease of qualification are not selection evidence.

ranking_axes.test: Prefer a substantive theorem or obstruction with a real mathematical mechanism over a routine identity, finite instance, or renamed transport.
Prefer a direct consequence for an Erdős target or a faithful exact reduction to its remaining endpoint, while keeping any missing producer explicit.
Expose the hard certificate, averaging, recurrence, or obstruction step and the hypotheses that make it work; do not flatten friction into a headline.
Prefer a result that adds a distinct mathematical route or support class rather than a corollary or duplicate wrapper.
Prefer a statement whose exact scope, source attribution, and significance can be checked by a reader without reconstructing hidden context.
Prefer a result that teaches a reusable mechanism and connects the source theorem to the open boundary.
Require an exact current source declaration, committed Challenge transport, and source-checked hypotheses and conclusion.
Penalize hidden conditionality, missing cofinal supply, and language that could be read as solving a still-open problem.

presentation_tiers.label: source-ranked frontier
presentation_tiers.reader_role: The explicitly ranked exceptional spine: completed direct results first, then the strongest conditional endpoint routes and deep structural results.

presentation_tiers.label: conditional endpoint leverage
presentation_tiers.reader_role: Exact target-facing consumers and reductions whose named producer or bridge remains open; their leverage is shown before medium machinery, with every premise adjacent.

presentation_tiers.label: deep mechanism and classification
presentation_tiers.reader_role: Reusable exact normal forms, classifications, geometric mechanisms, and structural obstructions that sharpen the problem without themselves being endpoint theorems.

presentation_tiers.label: natural friction and no-go
presentation_tiers.reader_role: Countermodels and exact route obstructions that explain why tempting coefficient, finite, local, or model-specific arguments do not reach an endpoint.

presentation_tiers.label: supporting and long tail
presentation_tiers.reader_role: Exact supporting identities, finite interfaces, budgets, technical inputs, and pending rows retained for drilldown rather than first-contact prominence.

relational_placements.relative_judgement: Below the ranked prime-gap equivalence but above the #269 carry-escape consumer, abstract dyadic-tail classification, and coefficient-only no-go: it is specialized to the actual prime-gap recurrence and identifies the precise cofinal adjacent-smallness producer, while that producer remains unproved.

Below the #251 small-mismatch route because the source-specific cofinal escape remains unproved, but above medium finite #269 machinery because the exact residue-window contradiction is the endpoint consumer that such machinery must feed. The actual-series reduction is given.

Below the source-specific conditional endpoint consumers but above negative-method evidence: its exact denominator and all-positive-tail-shift normal forms are deeper and more reusable than a coefficient-only obstruction, while supplying no actual-prime producer.

Below the #251 small-mismatch route and abstract integrality classification: it is valuable natural friction against coefficient-only reasoning, but its synthetic carry stream has no infinite-limit or actual-prime-gap identification bridge.

represented_family_placements.relative_judgement: The finite channel and projection machinery is the deepest represented #68 mechanism below the endpoint equivalence, but it supplies no cofinal obstruction.
represented_family_placements.hard_mechanism: One quotient band factors the factorial moment through a channel numerator; channel congruence preserves the moment modulo d! - 1, a prime translator gives an exact unit residual, and unequal sufficiently large divisor projections exclude a bounded endpoint.
represented_family_placements.open_boundary: No theorem supplies cofinally many non-unit carries, moving nontrivial private projections, or cofinally nonzero translated residuals, so the family does not prove Erdős #68 irrationality.

represented_family_placements.relative_judgement: The fresh-modulus obstruction explains why bounded rise would be decisive, but bounded rise is not automatic for the original reciprocal-tail orbit.
represented_family_placements.hard_mechanism: Exact reduced C/D dynamics make every earlier multiplier divide each later denominator while remaining coprime to the later reduced numerator. Distinct multipliers are therefore pairwise coprime fresh moduli; a numerator tending to infinity cannot keep crossing all of their forbidden residue windows with one uniform positive rise bound.
represented_family_placements.open_boundary: The theorem assumes eventual multiplier positivity above one, reduced coprimality, both exact recurrence equations, one fixed positive rise bound, and numerator escape to infinity. No theorem supplies that bounded-rise hypothesis for the original reciprocal-tail orbit, so no reciprocal-tail irrationality or Erdős #243 endpoint follows.

represented_family_placements.relative_judgement: This is a direct irrationality theorem for an exact structured coefficient class, but the totient-derived coefficients are not eventually periodic, so it is reusable background rather than a #249 frontier.

Below the actual-LCM, first-harmonic, and strict-prime producer routes but above medium totient kernel machinery: three exact equivalences expose the endpoint and certificate sockets, while the equivalent lcm-diagonal, period-multiple-kill, and separated-window producers all remain unresolved.
represented_family_placements.open_boundary: No lcm-diagonal certificate supply, period-multiple kill supply, or separated-window pair supply is proved for the actual totient series; no unconditional Erdős #249 result, novelty, priority, significance, or external-review claim follows.

represented_family_placements.relative_judgement: The Lambert rewrite and prime-power coefficient structure orient the programme but provide no irrationality producer.
The block and denominator criteria are reusable rational-state structure below the sharper all-positive-shift normal form and above propagation identities.
Propagation through totient-length shifts explains rational-state persistence but supplies no contradiction for the actual prime-gap recurrence.

The finite height-fibre normal form and smooth-shell bound are substantive three-prime structure, but they do not produce the source-specific cofinal escape. The actual-series reduction is given separately.
The exact four-symbol block alphabet is a useful finite interface, subordinate to the carry consumer, weighted observer, and rank obstruction.
The Newton value equation and exponential first integral are the load-bearing local mechanism, while metric gluing to a short curve remains open.
represented_family_placements.hard_mechanism: Away from a critical point, the complex Newton vector -f/f' cancels the derivative in the chain rule and gives w' = -w along a tangent curve. The product rule with the complex exponential then makes exp(t) * f(z(t)) a zero-derivative first integral, exposing radial exponential value decay and fixed argument.
represented_family_placements.open_boundary: These are pointwise complex-derivative statements. They do not prove real-time trajectory existence, integrate the local derivative identity globally, construct a connecting curve, preserve a component under perturbation, or perform the Reeb/topological and strict length-below-two fan-in required by Erdős #1041.

represented_family_placements.relative_judgement: Distinct value rays exactly obstruct finite Newton connections, a consequential route boundary but not the global lemniscate theorem.
represented_family_placements.hard_mechanism: The Newton-value endpoint relation is multiplication by the strictly positive scalar exp(-time), so every finite connection remains on one positive value ray; distinct rays therefore give an exact obstruction.
represented_family_placements.open_boundary: The theorem does not choose globally compatible critical-value rays, construct or glue the required flow geometry, or prove the Erdős #1041 lemniscate endpoint.

family_relations.reason: Finite channel rigidity feeds the carry endpoint route but supplies no cofinal non-unit carry.
Centered-state descent is the exact dynamics consumed by the bounded-negative exclusion.

Both recover eventual centered-state zero and Sylvester dynamics only under explicit hypotheses, but negative_mass_recovery uses summability of normalized negative mass whereas centered_state_dynamics uses a uniform lower-bound route; neither supplies the original-orbit premises.
Both imply #249 irrationality from different cofinal producers; neither producer is supplied.
The strict-prime route supplies a phase-density or natural-prime certificate mechanism, while the actual-LCM route instead assumes quantitative orbit separation; all producer predicates remain open.

Both feed the finite first-harmonic certificate socket, but strict-prime uses phase density or adaptive natural-prime escape while the pivot family uses a four-term supplier-fibre budget and residual decorrelation.
Certificate completeness identifies the exact finite endpoint socket but cannot manufacture the strict-prime route's missing phase-density, cofinal-prime, or uniform-margin producer.
Fixed local precision admits synthetic completions, so any successful projection must use growing precision or global correlation.
The abstract shift-integrality normal form explains what the actual-prime cofinal mismatch must destroy.
Coefficient irregularity alone is insufficient; the actual-prime adjacent-smallness producer is genuinely additional.

The reformulation gives the exact #251 target language; this fixed-shift actual-prime obstruction identifies what a cofinal adjacent-smallness/mismatch producer would have to destroy. It neither supplies that producer nor turns the reformulation into irrationality.
The Boolean–Möbius certificate reconstructs support, while exact rows still require a cofinal skip producer.

Cofinal positive half-greedy skips conditionally give 1/2-membership, which the seam iff classifies as unbounded terminal-false/upper-or-middle supply; finite exact rows supply neither cofinal premise.
The residue/coboundary split exposes finite carry data but does not supply the cofinal escape.
The finite kernel is not rank one, ruling out a tempting separable shortcut without producing carry escape.
The exponential first integral confines a Newton trajectory to one value ray, yielding the separation obstruction.
Ray separation motivates avoiding collision lines, but global topology and metric gluing remain open.
The sharp rectangular threshold analysis carries deeper model-specific information than the coordinatewise transfer obstruction, while neither proves the endpoint.

selection_contract.anti_underclaim_boundary: Do not select a timid proxy merely because it is easy to qualify: an unconditional direct theorem with a visible hard mechanism must remain eligible even when it is classical or leaves the universal problem open.
selection_contract.anti_hype_boundary: No selected result closes universal Erdős #257 or any other open programme; exact hypotheses, prior-art attribution, proof authority, limitations, and the surviving open boundary remain part of the result.
selection_contract.reversal_evidence: Reverse the choice only if a newly committed, source-checked Comparator row has a strictly stronger direct consequence at the same or closer endpoint, genuinely deeper independent mechanism, equal-or-better evidence certainty, and no larger hidden-hypothesis or overclaim risk; uncommitted dirt or a row count cannot reverse it.

source_family_disposition_contract.comparator_role: Comparator membership is an evidence, eligibility, and admission field nested below the source universe.

comparator_screen.semantic_role: Exact 51-row evidence/eligibility/admission screen nested inside the wider source universe; it does not define candidate-universe membership.

candidate_value_dispositions.authority_rule: The following groups partition exactly the committed Comparator roster. Source-landscape records preserve exact source identities, value judgments, and admission history; a source-landscape candidate is Comparator evidence only when its record names a committed source-faithful ExternalVerification row.

eligible_groups.reason: The unconditional full-support irrationality theorem has the clearest direct endpoint, a completed certificate mechanism, exact source identity, and the lowest overclaim risk when its b >= 2 and non-universal boundary remain visible.

These are genuinely distinct #257 support/coefficient routes and are represented in the high-signal spine; their exact structured or conditional hypotheses are part of their value and are not silently generalized.

The committed wrapper represents the one coherent actual_lcm_orbit_separation family. Its source-level sign, true-survivor, and top-edge mechanisms remain documented in the source-landscape record, while the cofinal separation supply and top-edge exclusion remain open; it stays below the unconditional full-support selection and is not duplicated.

The committed wrapper represents one coherent strict_prime_tail_orbit_gap family. Its 11/100 phase-density to 89/100 block saving to 9/10 finite-gap chain and adaptive natural-prime escape are distinct producer-side mechanisms; both global producer predicates remain unproved, so it stays below the actual-LCM and first-harmonic routes but above certificate-only normal forms.

The committed wrapper represents the one coherent first_harmonic_pivot_decomposition family. Its source-level fibre, counterexample, four-term decomposition, and 9/10 budget remain documented in the source-landscape record, while the cofinal decorrelation producer remains unproved; it stays below full support and is not split into pseudo-families.

The committed wrapper represents one coherent actual_foreign_residue_projection family: its finite partition, geometric majorant, and generic noncancellation consumer are endpoint-facing but remain below the actual-LCM and first-harmonic routes because the controlled-projection bridge and unbounded separated supply are open.

These newly registered representatives preserve twelve distinct source-current families: the retained synthetic #249 fixed-precision no-go, the #251 coefficient-only negative method and actual-prime-gap small-mismatch criterion, the two distinct signed #243 recovery criteria, abstract #251 dyadic-tail classification, sharp model-specific #1049 rectangular Hermite–Padé threshold equality, #249 orbit-level carry anti-compression, the #257 Boolean–Möbius support reconstruction and exact-row dynamics routes, the #257 half-membership seam classification, and the #269 weighted-phase residue observer. Each is represented with exact hypotheses and open producer/no-go boundaries, not promoted to a universal endpoint proof.

These two unconditional mechanisms materially sharpen their programmes without reaching an endpoint: the #249 theorem supplies clean binary-cyclotomic anchors but not the remaining carry-kill producer, while the #1041 theorem reaches the sharp two-root metric scale at a critical point but does not keep the broken line inside the open lemniscate.

Each is mathematically useful and independently retained, but the factorial and prime-gap rows are endpoint reductions without their missing producers, the #249 rank result does not itself prove irrationality or cofinal certificate supply, and the #269 carry-escape consumer retains an open cofinal-window producer. The actual-series reduction is given; the source-specific cofinal escape remains unproved. Comparator admission strengthens traceability, not endpoint status.
This is a sharp no-go for one proof architecture, not a direct endpoint or a complete candidate mechanism; it remains visible as a boundary rather than being promoted as a solution.

These exact identities, finite instances, structural consumers, auxiliary facts, and no-go boundaries remain in the complete current roster, but they are not competitive with the selected endpoint under the current consequence, mechanism, and evidence ranking.

source_landscape_candidates.statement: Along a curve tangent to the noncritical complex Newton field -f/f', the polynomial value has derivative equal to its own negative, and exp(t) times that value has derivative zero.
exact_hypotheses: At one complex time t, f has complex derivative f'(z(t)) at z(t).
The curve z has complex derivative newtonFlowVector (f(z(t))) (f'(z(t))) at t.
The derivative value f'(z(t)) is nonzero, so the Newton-vector cancellation is valid.
source_landscape_candidates.conclusion: The source proves the pointwise value equation d(f∘z)/dt = -f(z(t)) and the zero derivative of exp(t) * f(z(t)); these are the local differential form of exponential radial decay, not a global flow or short-curve theorem.
source_landscape_candidates.hard_mechanism: The chain rule multiplies f'(z(t)) by -f(z(t))/f'(z(t)); noncriticality cancels the denominator exactly. The exponential derivative and product rule then cancel the remaining value term, yielding the first integral that underlies fixed-argument ray geometry.
source_landscape_candidates.attribution: These source-current Lean declarations are in NewtonFlowRaySeparation.lean:50,64 and are canonically bound to newton_value_decay by Claims commit 06198c0a. No novelty, priority, significance, or external-review claim is made.
limitations: The statements are local HasDerivAt facts over a complex parameter and do not establish a real-time solution on a prescribed interval or integrate the first integral globally.

Ray separation is a geometric consumer of this invariant; translation avoidance and root retention are separate perturbative supports rather than proofs of trajectory existence or component stability.
No Morse/Reeb topology or decomposition, saddle and annular-cut gluing, collar-slack transfer, curve of length less than two, or Erdős #1041 endpoint follows.
source_landscape_candidates.source_landscape_rank_relative_to: Above ray_separation, translation_avoidance, root_retention, and finite search as the common load-bearing local invariant, but below direct completed endpoint families because global flow existence, topology, perturbation stability, and strict metric fan-in remain open.
source_landscape_candidates.contrary_evidence: The invalid local saddle-block route and the unresolved global-flow/component-stability/length obligations show that exact value decay alone cannot be promoted to a connecting-curve theorem.
source_landscape_candidates.reason: Represented as the strongest underweighted #1041 mechanism: it is the exact local invariant consumed by every ray-based route, while the separate finite perturbation theorems and open global topology remain visible rather than being flattened into a false endpoint.
source_landscape_candidates.reversal_evidence: A source-faithful Comparator transport would strengthen executable review evidence; a proved relative global Newton-flow theorem plus component-stable topological and strict length fan-in would justify endpoint-facing promotion, while another local derivative identity or finite search would not.

source_landscape_candidates.statement: For an eventually reduced exact reciprocal-tail recurrence, distinct multipliers are pairwise coprime, and a numerator escaping to infinity cannot have one uniform positive upper bound on all eventual rises.
exact_hypotheses: The reduced-tail theorem assumes natural-valued multiplier, numerator, and denominator sequences with eventual multiplier greater than one and pointwise coprimality of each reduced numerator-denominator pair.
The exact recurrences are u(n+1) + v(n) = a(n) * u(n) and v(n+1) = a(n) * v(n) from one eventual index onward.

candidate_selection.statement: For every integer base b >= 2, the full-support Erdős–Borwein series sum over k >= 0 of 1/(b^(k+1)-1) is irrational.
candidate_selection.open_boundary: This proves the full-support series only; irrationality for every infinite support in Erdős #257 remains open.
candidate_selection.hard_mechanism: The source proof closes a weighted divisor-block certificate pipeline: a bounded Bertrand/CRT first-block frame, middle-window divisor-pair averaging with pigeonhole selection, weighted tail control, and explicit parameter closure. The local theorem is the final consumer of that completed machine.
candidate_selection.why_this_is_the_showcase: It is the strongest direct and unconditional endpoint result in the committed Comparator spine: a canonical full-support member of Erdős #257 with a visible completed mechanism and a clean statement-isolated Challenge type. Its classical attribution is disclosed, not hidden, and does not diminish its review value.
candidate_selection.attribution: The source docstring records Erdős (1948) for the full-support theorem; the local Lean proof is the proof authority, while the cited source and repository prior-art ledger supply attribution and statement-fidelity context.
limitations: It proves only the full-support series, not irrationality for every infinite support.
It does not solve universal Erdős #257.
The base condition b >= 2 is part of the theorem and no other base or support interpretation is implicit.
Comparator establishes statement identity and configured axiom use, not novelty or editorial significance.

selection_comparison.reason: This newly committed #249 row is the strongest endpoint-near alternative: its exact source-faithful separation supply implies irrationality through a quantitative signed-margin mechanism. It remains below full support because the cofinal supply is a premise rather than a completed producer, so selecting it would carry a larger hidden-hypothesis risk.

It is the nearest alternative and remains a high-value distinct result, but its infinitude, pairwise-coprimality, and summable-reciprocal hypotheses cover a narrower support class; the selected full-support theorem has the more canonical direct endpoint and a completed divisor-block certificate pipeline.

Its bouquet and uniform tail-selection hypotheses expose a deeper conditional route, but those structural hypotheses are not constructed for arbitrary supports; its evidence boundary is therefore weaker for an unconditional showcase.
It is a sharp, useful no-go result, but it excludes one proof architecture and concludes no irrationality statement; it is lower consequence for the selected Palomar candidate.
It is an exact #68 endpoint reduction with excellent review value, but its cofinal non-unit-carry producer remains unproved; an equivalence to the open endpoint is not a direct irrationality result.

It is a deep independent #249 structural theorem, but infinite-dimensional kernel rank is farther from the irrationality endpoint than the selected direct result and does not supply the missing unbounded certificate family.

candidate_screening.reason: Exact #68 equivalence, but the carry formulation is the more informative route and neither form supplies the required cofinal witness.

A single coefficient-free cofinal complementary-tail certificate would imply the #68 endpoint, but the certificate supply is an explicit unproved premise; this is a shorter conditional consumer, not an irrationality proof.
Excludes a bounded-negative regime only under explicit dynamical hypotheses; it does not decide the unrestricted reciprocal-tail endpoint.
Retires an eventually-periodic negative orbit architecture, but leaves arbitrary unbounded negative behaviour and the #243 target open.

Exact finite-level dyadic rank growth is strong #249 structure and supports totient_carry_anti_compression, but it is weaker than that orbit-level rationality consequence and provides neither a contradiction nor unbounded certificate supply.

Infinite-dimensionality is the coefficient-side consequence of exact kernel-rank growth; it supports anti-compression but is farther from hypothetical rationality and gives no finite-rank contradiction or certificate producer.
An explicit basis is useful kernel infrastructure, yet it does not connect finite span structure to the binary totient irrationality endpoint.
The rank theorem retains an external linear-independence hypothesis, so it is valuable structural support rather than an unconditional endpoint result.
Exact visible-lattice normalization explains a mass term but is rational and does not settle Erdős #249.
A precise gcd-moment transfer identity, but it supplies no irrationality conclusion for the binary totient series.
A genuine Fibonacci/continuant stability floor, but analytic denominator survival and the #249 endpoint remain unproved.
Exact Stern–Brocot telescoping is reusable geometry, not an irrationality theorem or novelty claim.
A synthetic finite-shift obstruction retires one algebraic route while explicitly leaving actual totient forcing and the unbounded supply open.

The theorem gives an unconditional cofinal supply of clean prime factors on composite binary-cyclotomic rays. It removes the anchor-existence obstruction for certificate routes, but the denominator-filtered carry-kill supply and the #249 irrationality endpoint remain open.
Prime-gap unboundedness is exact background for #251, but unbounded coefficients alone do not force irrationality.

The exact transport packages the finite carry partial-sum identity and synthetic coefficient non-eventual-periodicity against actual prime-gap nonperiodicity. It is valuable natural-friction evidence below direct endpoints and above routine finite searches, but has no Lean infinite-limit theorem, stream identification, or #251 endpoint.

This actual-prime fixed-shift obstruction is the first conditional-endpoint-leverage screen: strict smallness makes two integral adjacent tail shifts zero, so the exact recurrence contradicts the supplied unequal prime gaps. Its cofinal small-mismatch and actual-smallness producer remains unproved; it is not #251 irrationality or an infinite rational-sum result.

The registered representative is the all-positive-tail-shifts irrationality normal form for the abstract dyadic recurrence; denominator and congruence classifiers remain source-level mechanism evidence, and the prime-specific cofinal producer is open.
The exact window-residue contradiction is retained as subordinate #269 conditional endpoint leverage. The actual-series reduction is given; the source-specific cofinal escape remains unproved.

The exact residue-digit/coboundary decomposition is the committed representative of the weighted-phase observer family; it does not transport the separate finite-dimensional factorization or imply the #269 endpoint.
The full-measure achievement-set theorem is consequential geometry, but it does not classify rational points or settle infinite-support irrationality.
The finite-period order interface is exact denominator infrastructure, but finite support cannot decide an infinite-support sum.
The restricted-set measure dichotomy is structurally useful but does not classify rational values or prove universal irrationality.
It extracts a modular tail state only from explicit rational-support hypotheses and therefore does not exclude rational infinite supports.
The exact composite-dilation defect exposes a real obstruction, but it supplies neither a tail selector nor an unconditional irrationality result.
Sharp local 2-adic band arithmetic excludes small odd numerators under stated hypotheses, but does not decide reachability or half-membership.
A checked minor obstruction rules out rank one in a displayed finite kernel, but failure of rank one does not imply irrationality.
The smooth-prefix LCM identity is exact three-prime structure, but it does not supply the missing irrationality bridge.

The committed source-faithful representative exposes the signed centered-state recovery theorem with exact natural C/D dynamics, strict centered margin, lower bound, and normalized vanishing; the centered-zero and Sylvester recovery lemmas remain subordinate, and no reciprocal-tail irrationality follows.
Finite translation avoidance is a useful #1041 input, yet it does not provide the global gluing needed by the target route.
Root retention under small perturbation is an exact local input, not a complete stationarity or minimax conclusion.

At a critical point, the theorem finds two distinct roots whose broken-line distance through that point is at most twice the geometric-mean root distance. It strengthens the Newton/critical-point geometry to the sharp metric scale, but it does not prove that the two segments stay inside the open lemniscate.
It excludes one coordinatewise corridor architecture at base 3/2 and proves no irrationality statement.
The cleared-tail recurrence is exact rational-base infrastructure, but no contradiction or irrationality consequence is derived.

The committed representative unconditionally retires fixed-positive-precision local valuation/unit-word escape for every finite odd-unit word through centred completions, while its synthetic unrestricted high-quotient and finite-word scope supplies no actual totient endpoint.

The committed representative preserves the existence-level quotient certificate, Boolean Möbius support reconstruction, positivity, and square-root bound; it supplies no universal irrationality contradiction or actual-recurrence producer.

The committed exact-row representative is one conditional Boolean–Möbius dynamics family: cofinal positive greedy skips yield cofinally many exact local half rows and conditional 1/2-membership, while finite rows do not supply the unproved cofinal premise.

The registered representative is the sharp equality characterization for the explicit rectangular two-function exponent model; it is not a universal Hermite-Padé no-go and does not produce irrationality.

The committed representative exposes the exact finite foreign/divisor partition, geometric tail control, and generic separated-projection consumer for the canonical actual_foreign_residue_projection family; its controlled-projection bridge and unbounded supply remain open, so it is represented conditional evidence rather than a #249 endpoint.

version: "v0.4"
project:
  name: "Eight open Erdős problems: checked subsidiary mathematics"
  description: "Lean 4 formalization of subsidiary mathematics for eight open Erdős problems, including unconditional irrationality theorems for structured Mersenne supports, exact conditional endpoint reductions, arithmetic classifications, and method barriers; none of the eight open problems is claimed solved."
  authors:
    - "Will Cook"
  license: "Apache-2.0"
  responsible_maintainers:
    - "Will Cook"

  arxiv: ["math.NT", "math.CO"]
  msc2020: ["11J72"]
sources:
  - title: "Erdős Problems 68, 243, 249, 251, 257, 269, 1041, and 1049"
